title: SSO Authentication Failures - Production Environment
description: Multiple users reporting authentication failures when attempting to access production applications via SSO. Error message indicates token validation failure. Affecting approximately 50 users across multiple departments.

title: VPN Connection Intermittent - Remote Office
description: Remote office in Chicago experiencing intermittent VPN connectivity. Users report being disconnected every 15-20 minutes. Network team suspects ISP routing issue or VPN concentrator problem.

title: Storage Array Capacity Alert - 85% Full
description: Production storage array STORAGE-PROD-01 has reached 85% capacity. Current growth rate suggests 90% will be reached within 48 hours. Expansion or data cleanup required urgently.

title: Ransomware Detection - Marketing File Server
description: Security tools detected potential ransomware activity on FILESERVER-MKT-01. Server has been isolated from network. Security team investigating scope of infection. Backups being verified for restoration.

title: Application Performance Degradation - ERP System
description: ERP application response times have increased from 2 seconds to 15+ seconds. Database queries running slower than normal. Affecting order processing and inventory management.

title: Backup Job Failure - SQL Database
description: Nightly backup job for SQLDB-PROD-02 failed at 02:30 AM. Error indicates insufficient disk space on backup target. Last successful backup was 48 hours ago.

title: Email Server Memory Leak - Exchange
description: Exchange server memory usage climbing steadily, currently at 92%. Server requires restart but needs to be scheduled during maintenance window to minimize impact.

title: Firewall High CPU Utilization
description: Primary datacenter firewall showing sustained 85%+ CPU utilization. Causing packet drops and connection delays. Traffic analysis shows unusual spike in outbound HTTPS connections.

title: VM Cluster Failover Required - Planned Maintenance
description: Hypervisor host requires firmware update. Need to migrate 15 VMs to secondary host and perform rolling maintenance. Scheduled for tonight at 11 PM.

title: Certificate Expiration Warning - Load Balancer
description: SSL certificate on primary load balancer expires in 7 days. Certificate renewal and deployment must be completed before expiration to avoid service disruption.
